name: Vinvin AI Visibility Tools
author: vinvin27

sections.description:
People now ask AI assistants what to buy, who to call and which company to trust. Vinvin AI Visibility Tools shows you what those assistants can read on your WordPress site, and lets you decide which AI crawlers may use it. It does nothing at all until you switch something on.

1. A checklist of what your site shows to AI assistants

One click reads your own home page, robots.txt, llms.txt and sitemap, and gives a score out of 100 with a plain-language list of what to fix:

  • are AI search and answer crawlers allowed in, or blocked by mistake?
  • can your home page be indexed (“Discourage search engines” and noindex)?
  • does your home page say who you are in structured data?
  • title, meta description and one clear H1;
  • is there real text in the HTML, for crawlers that do not run JavaScript?
  • do your images have descriptions;
  • are an XML sitemap and an llms.txt published?

The check runs on your own server and reads only your own site. Nothing is sent anywhere.

2. AI crawler controls grouped by purpose

For each known AI crawler, choose “Leave as is”, “Allow” or “Block”. Crawlers are grouped by what they do, so you can make a different choice for each group: search and answers (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot), fetches made when a person asks an assistant about your page (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User) and model training (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Bytespider, Amazonbot). You can, for example, stay visible in AI answers while refusing model training. The plugin warns you when a physical robots.txt file or the “Discourage search engines” setting would make your choices ineffective.

3. Optional extras

  • llms.txt: a short Markdown page at /llms.txt with your summary, key pages and latest posts, with a preview. Off by default.
  • Organization data: a small schema.org block on your home page, if your SEO plugin does not already add one. Off by default.

What this plugin does not do

  • It does not promise that any assistant will mention you. llms.txt is a community proposal and no assistant is guaranteed to read it; crawler rules are requests that well-behaved crawlers follow.
  • It cannot change a robots.txt or llms.txt file that physically exists in your site folder: your web server serves those directly. The plugin tells you when it finds one.
  • It does not measure whether assistants name your business. For that, the author runs a free live audit on his own website, linked from the checklist.

Privacy

Vinvin AI Visibility Tools does not contact any other server, sets no cookies and collects no data. The checklist makes requests to your own site only.

More details in the plugin presentation (in French).

Developed by a WordPress developer in Montreal.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the vinvin-ai-visibility-tools folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Settings > AI Visibility and press “Run the check”.
  4. Use the AI crawlers, llms.txt and Identity tabs to switch on what you want. Nothing is changed until you save.
sections.faq:
Does activating the plugin change my site?

No. Every feature is off until you turn it on: crawlers are set to “Leave as is”, llms.txt is not published and no structured data is added.

My crawler choices have no effect.

Look for a physical robots.txt file in your site folder (next to wp-config.php). If it exists, the web server serves it and WordPress never builds a robots.txt: delete the file or copy the rules into it. The plugin shows a warning when it finds one. Some SEO or security plugins and CDNs also write or override robots.txt.

/llms.txt gives a 404.

Check that “Publish llms.txt” is ticked and saved, that permalinks are not set to “Plain”, and that no physical llms.txt file exists. If you just installed the plugin on a site with a caching plugin, clear its cache.

Should I block the training crawlers?

That is your choice, and the plugin does not make it for you. Blocking training crawlers asks companies not to use your pages to train their models. Blocking search and answer crawlers makes it harder for assistants to find and quote you.

It says my home page could not be read.

Some hosts block a site from calling itself, and local or password-protected sites cannot be reached. The checks that need the home page are skipped and the score is worked out from the others.

Does it work with Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO?

Yes. They may also write a robots.txt, llms.txt or organization data. Use one source for each: the checklist shows what your site actually serves.
